observed_error: The response budgets fuel for only the 165-mile outbound journey; its written arithmetic is correct.
violated_condition: If the trip includes returning home, fuel must cover twice the stated distance.
error_description: The response uses the 165-mile distance to Sea World as the entire driving distance when calculating fuel costs. reference_review_reason: The reference assumes a round trip, doubling the distance, although return travel is not explicitly specified in the question.
uncertainty_note: Whether the one-way fuel budget is erroneous depends on the intended scope of the trip.
